intelligence.essence: Makers must prove the tap works before they file, so rounds land right the first time. A code audit can pass a page that a finger cannot use — the tap is the only proof that survives contact with his hand.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine someone says "the door works!" — but they never actually opened it! You have to push the door yourself, sweetheart, and walk through it, before you say it works!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — it's not enough to say a button works, dear, you have to press it yourself and see it do its job, love. A page that looks right but doesn't open when you tap it isn't finished, dear — it's just a picture of finished. We press every button before we say done, love.
